source.name: Opening a drawer must move keyboard focus into it, to its autofocus field when it has one
source.scope: Open upstream bug (https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/issues/43120) at 2bb544eb426e9b1e019c2a98798e0002b8a41d35, unfixed when pinned. Routing Super, then Ultra.

journey.title: Open the filters drawer, land on its autofocus search field, and apply a filter with the keyboard
journey.goal: Opening the drawer moves focus into it, so the user can tick a filter and show results without a pointer

functionalJourney.title: Apply a filter with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Clicking Filters, ticking Waterproof and clicking Show results applies the filter

guards.title: Escape closes the drawer and returns focus to Filters
guards.goal: After opening the drawer with the pointer, Escape closes it and focus is back on the Filters button

attempts.failure: Invalid proposal schema: edits: Invalid input: expected array, received undefined

plan.root_cause: The drawer component relies on native <dialog> autofocus behavior when shown modally, but the browser does not move focus to the autofocus element in this configuration, leaving focus on the body after opening.
plan.repair_strategy: Add a 'shown.bs.drawer' event listener in the Drawer constructor to explicitly focus the first element with an autofocus attribute after the drawer finishes opening.

edits.before:
constructor(element?: string | Element | null, config?: Partial<DrawerConfig> | null) {
    super(element, config)
    this._swipeHelper = null
    this._resizeObserver = null
    this._resizeFrame = null
    this._initResizeObserver()
  }

plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users opening the filters drawer will have focus land on the search input, enabling immediate interaction without manual tabbing.
functional_risks: Minimal: only adds focus management for autofocus elements, aligning with expected native dialog behavior.
Does not affect non-modal drawers or existing focus restoration on close.
verification_requirements: The journey step 'Open the drawer' must pass the focus assertion for #filters-search after pressing Enter on #filters-open.
Regression guard 'Escape closes the drawer and returns focus to Filters' must continue to pass.
